notes:
Summary: MavenWell is a mid-to-large health system technology org building a clinical documentation search product for inpatient/outpatient records. Primary goal: rapid, clinically precise retrieval (RAG) with deterministic PHI controls and exhaustive audit trails.

Key requirements / constraints:
- Index scale: planning to index 30-75M clinical notes (note-level vectors + metadata), initial POC 5M. Concerned about shard sizing, cold-start ingest time.
- Query profile: mix of clinician interactive low-latency queries (p50 < 300ms target) and batch research queries (higher throughput, can tolerate higher latency).
- Cost target: expect unit cost per interactive query < $0.02 (embeddings + reranker + retrieval). Looking for model/kernel suggestions to meet cost SLOs.
- Models: prefer open/quantized encoders (sentence-transformer family or LLM-lite for embeddings) + a lightweight cross-encoder reranker (smaller transformer) for top-20 re-rank. Need guidance on tradeoffs.
- Routing / fallback: want automatic fallback to cached embeddings and cheaper model variants during peak loads; policy must preserve PHI controls.
- Security: must sign BAA; require VPC peering or on-prem air-gapped option for PHI; KMS integration + HSM for key custody; detailed audit logs per-token and per-user; SSO/SAML + SCIM.
- Data residency: all PHI must remain in US-East regions; retention controls and redaction hooks required.

POC plan discussed:
- Phase 1: ingest 5M de-identified notes, run embedding index (annoy/hnsw or hybrid), simple retrieval + light reranker; evaluate P50/P95 latency and MRR.
- Phase 2: scale to 25-50M, perf tuning (batching, cache, kernel selection), run budgeted cost-per-query calc.
- Phase 3: security sign-off, contract (BAA), onsite or private deployment.

Quotes / client voice:
- "We need explainable relevance — clinicians will challenge false positives." - Director of Clinical AI
- "If we can't keep everything inside our VPC, legal won't sign off." - Head of Security

Open action items / risks:
- Security team asked for HSM architecture diagram and SOC2 artifact set (in Drive). Waiting on SE draft.
- Legal needs BAA template; finance wants ARR band confirmation before procurement.
- Performance risk: reranker cost could blow cost budget if top-K rerank not constrained. Need Redwood Optimize recommendations for hybrid rerank.

Recommended Redwood plays (from AE/SE):
- Private deployment + dedicated capacity for steady clinician traffic; use Optimize to recommend quantized encoders + CPU fallback for low-priority batch; configure automatic prefix cache for common queries; set reranker to run on top-20 with budget cap.
